summary.intent: Work through two pending todos: (1) wire CTR encryption for SDK media uploads, and (2) debug BYO-IPFS register-cid 400 errors on staging. Both required fixing root bugs, cleaning up pre-existing test debt, and getting PRs merged.
summary.outcome: PR #399 merged: SDK now selects CTR vs GCM based on MIME type + size, with centralized encryption-mode module. PR #400 open: added PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint (setByoStatus was dead code), fixed load test ipns-publish wrong fields, fixed 9 API test files with broken mock patterns, and excluded Rust target/ from ESLint.

repo: setByoStatus() existed as a vault service method but had no controller endpoint — BYO mode was never actually togglable via the API, causing register-cid to always return 403
STREAMING_MIME_TYPES was duplicated between packages/sdk/src/client.ts and apps/web/src/services/streaming-crypto.service.ts — centralized into packages/sdk-core/src/encryption-mode.ts
SDK test files that mock @cipherbox/sdk-core with bare factory functions drop all real exports when new ones are added — must use importActual + spread pattern
jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> loses mock methods after module.get() in NestJS test modules — use the mock object directly instead of re-fetching from module
pnpm api:generate requires the API server to be running (it calls the live server to generate the OpenAPI spec)
orval generates entire src/ trees including new subdirectories — must stage all of packages/api-client/src/ not just specific files, or CI drift check fails
Rust build artifacts land in target/ at repo root and were being scanned by ESLint, causing 261 spurious errors — target/ was not in eslint.config.js ignores (only src-tauri/target/ was)
After merging a branch that moved a todo from pending/ to done/, both copies can land in main if the source branch had the pending copy committed separately

code.finding: Was hardcoded to encryptAesGcm + encryptionMode: 'GCM' — now accepts optional encryptionMode param and branches to CTR path
New centralized module: selectEncryptionMode(mimeType, size) and normalizeEncryptionMode(mode) — both sdk/client.ts and streaming-crypto.service.ts now import from here
Added PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint backed by existing setByoStatus() service method that was previously unreachable
ipns-publish step was sending { ipnsName, cid } but PublishIpnsEntryDto requires { ipnsName, record, metadataCid } — replaced with createAndPublishIpnsRecord from sdk-core
createByoClientPool never enabled BYO mode on test accounts — added PATCH /vault/byo-status call after account creation, with filtering of failed enables
Added 'target/**' to ignores — Rust cargo build output was causing 261 spurious ESLint errors per api:generate run
Remaining legitimate @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any warning — cast on jest.spyOn return value

workflow: sdk-core must be built before typechecking sdk — sdk imports compiled types from the dist output, not source
When running orval regeneration manually, always stage the entire packages/api-client/src/ directory tree, not individual files
Entire CLI modifies .husky/commit-msg locally — add both commit-msg and commit-msg.pre-entire to .git/info/exclude so they never appear in git status
The staging API server was returning 403 (not 400) on register-cid — the todo's error code was wrong, which initially misdirected investigation toward DTO validation

friction: GitHub GraphQL API timed out repeatedly during resolve-review-comments workflow — had to fall back to REST for fetching threads
Accidentally created apps/api/openapi.json (in cwd) instead of packages/api-client/openapi.json during manual spec generation — had to rm and push a cleanup commit
CI typecheck failed because orval-generated model files (12 new files + 2 new dirs from Phase 35 TEE endpoints) weren't all staged — orval's output scope expanded silently after main merged
Entire CLI kept modifying .husky/commit-msg, causing it to appear in every git diff until .git/info/exclude was configured
Both pending/ and done/ copies of the SDK todo ended up in main after merge, requiring manual cleanup
Pre-existing test type errors across 9 API spec files had to be fixed before typecheck would pass — all from the same jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> anti-pattern
open_items: PR #400 still open — pending CI green and merge
register-cid 400 errors on staging: actual root cause was missing BYO mode on test accounts (403) + wrong ipns-publish payload — needs validation on staging after PR #400 merges
MigrationStatusDto.completedAt typed as object instead of Date string — pre-existing issue from Phase 35 TEE migration, not addressed in this session
Todos 1-6 still pending: Web Worker file encryption, ERC-1271 contract wallet auth, CRDT IPNS inbox, async search index, alternative MFA factors, mock-ipns-routing removal
Load test ipns-publish now uses createAndPublishIpnsRecord but this requires real keypair data — verify the full BYO load test scenario works end-to-end on staging
